scope: Temporal-difference learning with linear features: the stationary-distribution norm, in which the transition matrix is nonexpansive (Jensen) and the Bellman operator a beta-contraction; linear value approximation with a coercive Gram form, the TD mean field strongly monotone and Lipschitz, existence and uniqueness of the TD fixed point; best approximation by the normal equations and the Tsitsiklis-Van Roy bound (1 - beta^2)||V_theta* - V||_d^2 <= ||Pi V - V||_d^2; almost sure convergence of TD(0) with i.i.d. sampling of transitions from the stationary distribution, via stochastic approximation with a quadratic Lyapunov function.
source: Sutton (1988); Tsitsiklis and Van Roy (1997); Robbins and Siegmund (1971).
